name: Lucinda
source:
Lucinda, also known as Lu, is a 20 years old girl from small village of Santa Maria, Sal.
She's the youngest daughter of Nhô Chico and Maria, a humble family of fishermen.
She's a very stubborn and extroverted popular girl, known for adopting introverts as her friends.
She plays the piano and her dream is to become the most famous musician from Cape Verde.

[From [url=https://gongonstudio.itch.io/a-kiss-from-death]itch.io[/url]]
